questions.q: How did Shere Khan win over the younger wolves of the Pack?
choices: He let them follow him for scraps and flattered them
He promised each of them a turn at leading the Pack
He taught them secret ways to hunt the village cattle
He threatened to kill their cubs if they disobeyed

questions.q: When Bagheera warned him about Shere Khan, why did Mowgli say he was not afraid?
choices: He had the Pack, Bagheera and Baloo to help him
He was sure he could beat the tiger in a fair fight
He believed Shere Khan had left the hills for good
He knew Mother Wolf would hide him in the cave
questions.evidence: I have the Pack and I have thee

questions.q: What did Mowgli do when Tabaqui told him he was a naked man's cub?
choices: Swung him by the tail against a palm-tree
Chased him all the way down to the village
Told Akela, who drove him from the Pack
Laughed at him and went back to sleep
questions.evidence: I caught Tabaqui by the tail and swung him twice against a palm-tree

questions.q: What did Mowgli find when Bagheera told him to feel under his jaw?
choices: A little bald spot left by a collar
An old scar from a fight with the tiger
A thorn that had been stuck there for years
A notch in his ear from a hunter's trap
questions.evidence: he came upon a little bald spot

questions.q: Why did Bagheera pay the price for Mowgli at the Council long ago?
choices: He too had been born among men, in the king's cages
He wanted a clever man's cub to help him hunt the buck
He owed Father Wolf a debt from an old fight
He hated Shere Khan and wanted to anger him
questions.evidence: It was because of this that I paid the price for thee

questions.q: Bagheera says the wolves hate Mowgli partly because they cannot meet his eyes. What does this show?
choices: They feel that he is a man and stronger than them in a way
They think he is rude for staring at them during Council
They believe he has gone mad like Tabaqui the jackal
They are jealous that he gets more food than they do
questions.evidence: because their eyes cannot meet thine

questions.q: "I did not know these things," said Mowgli sullenly. What does "sullenly" mean?
choices: In a gloomy, bad-tempered way
In a loud and cheerful voice
In a sleepy and careless manner
In a proud and boastful way

questions.q: What did Bagheera mean by "the Red Flower"?
choices: Fire
A poison flower that grows by the huts
The blood of a hunted buck
A bright red jungle berry
questions.evidence: By Red Flower Bagheera meant fire

questions.q: On his way down to the village, what did Mowgli hear happen to Akela?
choices: He sprang at a Sambhur and missed his hold
He was caught in a trap left by the villagers
He fought Shere Khan and was badly wounded
He was chased away from the Pack by Tabaqui
questions.evidence: The Lone Wolf must have sprung and missed his hold

questions.q: How did Mowgli learn the way to carry fire?
choices: He watched a village boy fill a wicker pot with hot charcoal
Bagheera showed him how men carried fire in iron pans
He remembered it from the night his parents ran away
Baloo taught him how to strike sparks from two stones
questions.evidence: fill it with lumps of red-hot charcoal

questions.q: Why was Mowgli not afraid of the Red Flower when Bagheera asked him?
choices: He remembered lying warm and happy beside it as a baby
He had seen Bagheera carry it many times without harm
He thought it was only a flower and could not hurt him
Mother Wolf had told him that fire was a friend to wolves
questions.evidence: I lay beside the Red Flower, and it was warm and pleasant

questions.q: What did Akela do at the Council Rock to show that the leadership of the Pack was open?
choices: He lay beside his rock instead of on it
He howled three long times at the moon
He gave his place to Shere Khan
He walked out of the circle alone
questions.evidence: lay by the side of his rock as a sign that the leadership of the Pack was open

questions.q: A leader who has missed his kill is called "the Dead Wolf." Why is he given this name?
choices: He will soon be killed by the Pack, so he does not live long
He has already died and only his ghost speaks at Council
He is too tired to hunt and must sleep like the dead
He is no longer allowed to eat with the other wolves
questions.evidence: he is called the Dead Wolf as long as he lives, which is not long

questions.q: What did Akela offer the Pack if they would let Mowgli go to his own people?
choices: To die without fighting when his time came
To lead them on one last great hunt for buck
To leave the hills forever and never return
To hand the leadership straight to Shere Khan

questions.q: What did Mowgli do right after flinging the fire pot to the ground?
choices: Lit his dead branch and whirled it above the wolves
Ran away from the Council Rock down toward the village
Begged the Pack to let him stay as their brother
Hid behind Bagheera as the moss burst into flame
questions.evidence: Mowgli thrust his dead branch into the fire till the twigs lit and crackled

questions.q: How did Mowgli punish Shere Khan at the Council?
choices: He beat him over the head with the burning branch
He set the tiger's striped coat on fire with coals
He made the young wolves chase him out of the hills
He tied him to a tree with vines and left him there
questions.evidence: He beat Shere Khan over the head with the branch

questions.q: Why did Bagheera say, "Now I know thou art a man," when Mowgli began to cry?
choices: Only men shed tears, and no wolf ever does
Mowgli had finally beaten the great tiger
Mowgli spoke to the Pack in a human tongue
Men are the only creatures who fear fire
questions.evidence: That is only tears such as men use

questions.q: What is this part of the story mostly about?
choices: Mowgli uses fire to save Akela and face Shere Khan, then must leave the jungle for men
Mowgli becomes the new leader of the Seeonee Pack after Akela grows too old to hunt
Bagheera escapes from the king's palace and learns the ways of the jungle wolves
Mowgli and the wolves together hunt down and kill Shere Khan near the village
questions.evidence: Mowgli went down the hillside alone, to meet those mysterious things that are called men
